## 403. The capacity to shape the rule, selected by what comes back to it (MA3)

`RuleCapture` takes the rule's being read from the share it selects as its premise (`ReadsShare`); MA2 moves it to who reads (`readers-drawn-from-the-selected`, landed 25 October, `7bdacfc28`). MA3 asks the other half of the meta-attractor's second order ([meta-attractor](../../../../../../theories/meta-attractor/README.md#selection-for-control-over-selection-2026-10-02-after-review), "recursive selection creates second-order selection pressure for mechanisms that increase control over future selection"): where the capacity to shape the rule is itself carried from parent to offspring, what selects it? It serves alignment (what a joint selection of humans, institutions and trained systems favours where its rule can be shaped, and the levers), and it is step 2 of board item AJ's plan.

**What was built.** A new leaf module `Becoming.RuleShaping` on `Becoming.RuleCapture`, importing `Becoming.Recurrence` for `Law.orbit` and `Becoming.SelectionTerm` for its axiom-free cancellation (`SelectionTerm.lt_of_mul_lt_mul`). A leaf: a model of selection on the capacity, which nothing below needs. `Nat.lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left` of Lean's library carries `propext`, `Classical.choice` and `Quot.sound` and was replaced; every other library lemma used has an empty report.

**What it says.** At a step, the capacity to shape the rule is selected by the part of what it gives that comes back to it alone, net of its cost; the part every member receives does not decide the direction, though it pulls the rule toward even. Across a stretch what decides is how many steps carry the cost before anything comes back and how many with it, and there the base and the shared part enter: a shared part can turn the verdict. Where what comes back exceeds the cost, enough steps with it outweigh any number before it, so timing binds only where the steps with it are bounded. On the reading of what comes back from the share, `ReadsShare` is equivalent to what comes back being monotone in the share; monotone and covering the cost, the lock of `RuleCapture` holds of the capacity, and at a threshold the course tips. The lever named on 2 October is exact at a step: with nothing coming back to the shapers and a cost the capacity falls, and with no cost to them alone as well it is selected neither way.

**The review, and what was taken.** One independent read-only review by a separate AI agent checked every docstring against its declaration. Taken: (1) "what is shared selects nothing, however large" was false across a stretch: the shared part joins the base and can turn the verdict, now stated and witnessed (`shaped_shift`, `SharedFlips`); at a step it pulls the rule toward even either way, now with `shared_raises` beside `shared_lowers`, each with its hypothesis. (2) "`ReadsShare` is derived" overstated `byBack_reads_iff`, an equivalence that moves the premise onto what comes back; the lock needs that monotonicity, now named wherever the lock is stated. (3) A reading claimed that a shaping of the rule's value returns until the next reading step at most; false, since the share it moved stays and, carried across a threshold, holds the course: the reading now says so. "Correction", retired as dualist in the naming study (§9), was replaced by "duration" and `Timing.corrected_falls` by `Timing.shorter_falls`. (4) Timing: products commute, so only the number of steps of each kind matters; one more step before anything comes back is what `wait_not_more` compares; with what comes back exceeding the cost a long enough stretch with it always wins (`Timing.seven_falls`, `Timing.eight_rises`); the verdict depends on the base, and so on how the cost is read. (5) The tipping point was only "neither side is left"; the strict tipping point under `lo < c < hi` is now proved (`threshold_rises`, `threshold_falls`), with the rule in force constant on each side. (6) Names: exchange words (`paying`, `cheaper`), "return", which names recurrence across the core (`Law.Returns`, `LoopReturn`), and `pool`, which names the coupling of `SelectionPool`, were replaced; `paying` and `returning`, equal by `rfl` to the rule after shaping with zeros, were dropped; `open_falls`, which clashed with `ClosedCapture.Beyond.open_falls`, became `nothing_back_falls`; the witness namespace in which nothing comes back became `Split`. (7) "The same total return" was imprecise: the witnesses give `s + p = 5` to each shaper. (8) Weak `favours` and the boundaries of constant `s` and `p` are now stated. (9) The landing texts and the board row repeated these claims and were corrected with them.

**Constructivity.** No omniscience principle is used; the threshold reads a decidable comparison of counts.

**Self-review.** (1) Every docstring, the module header and the home paragraph were read against their declarations after the review. (2) Not done: the items in Boundary, among them a theorem joining MA2's readers.
